evidence.exact_span: There is no suggestion in the copy of the arrest warrant or indeed in any document whatsoever, that the applicant was to apply such advance commission payments in any particular way, that being a requirement of s 178A.

Did the applicant, in fact, provide the guarantee? Did he provide the guarantee to someone else who in turn provided it to MCI? In particular, it is said that there is no allegation whatsoever that the applicant knew that the guarantee was forged.
